clues: This town is in the north of its land. It sits on a small river, a short way from a great city.
Air moves very little in this city, and the high Alps stand close by. In winter, that still air brings cold days and thick, lingering fog.
A Lombard queen set up her royal home in this place long ago. She also founded its first great church, the seed of the church there now.
One of the oldest car race tracks in the world stands in this city. The great Italian Grand Prix has run on it for many years.
Inside its great church rests the Iron Crown, an old crown tied to the crowning of kings of Italy. Even Charlemagne is linked to its long tale.
